mapper.sql: id, project_id, document_no, document_name, document_type, document_category, file_path, file_size, file_format, version_no, archive_date, archiver_id, storage_location, retention_period, access_level, document_status, keywords, document_summary, related_documents, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE document_type = #{documentType} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE archiver_id = #{archiverId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE document_status = #{documentStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR document_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR document_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM document_archive WHERE document_no = #{documentNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT document_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN document_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN document_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactive_count, SUM(CASE WHEN document_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as archived_count FROM document_archive GROUP BY document_type ORDER BY document_type
